decisions.what: The kettle hangs from its rim flange. It does not stand on the floor. The plant model's five kettle props are deleted.
decisions.why: Rev H's validation treats the kettle as suspended (76–78 t), and Rev K's levels leave 515 mm under the kettle. STL-EF Rev D gives a stress-checked load path for this exact envelope. The as-built SH-INS furnaces stand the kettle on the ground or on HD board. That is a different arrangement, and the reconciliation itself lists it as unknown.
decisions.src: Rev H, Rev K, STL-EF, SH-INS

decisions.what: The rim flange is 120 × 40, continuous (STL-EF). The SH-INS top closure is kept relative to the flange underside: a 50 × 12 lip plate 200 mm below it, 25 mm HD boards, 3 × 50 blanket, and 25 mm clear.
decisions.why: The flange is part of the load path. The SH-INS 25 × 200 "top plate" was a heat seal on a floor-standing kettle.

decisions.what: The cap beam is a fabricated box 300 × 100 × 10 on the casing top (+0.150 → +0.250). A 6 mm chequered sectional deck sits at +0.256, so the rim (+0.300) stands 44 mm proud as a spill lip.
decisions.why: This keeps Rev K's casing top and rim levels. STL-EF's SHS 300 × 150 used a lower rim datum.

decisions.what: The hearth is built up as: 10 plate + 2 × 25 CaSi + 25 microporous + 3 × 50 blanket 64 kg/m³ (A–B–A strips per SH-INS) + 25 HD board wear face. The hearth surface is at −1.315, leaving 255 mm under the kettle.
decisions.why: A suspended kettle puts hot gas on the floor. The SH-INS B3 blanket alone, laid on the pad, would take the RCC to ≈556 °C in steady state.

decisions.what: The wall lining is 250 mm: 175 folded module 128 kg/m³ 1430 grade, Z-anchored, + 50 microporous + 25 CaSi, with a 50 mm rebate above the HD-board seat.
decisions.why: Skin is 61–65 °C at a 900–1,000 °C hot face, against 75–81 °C for all-fibre 200 + 50. Wall loss falls by ≈40 %. Rev K's 53–55 °C target cannot be reached in 250 mm (O-08).
decisions.src: Rev K, SH-INS, STL-EF REF data

decisions.what: Kettle corners are bent R250 inside / R300 outside. The corner shields are rolled to R350.
decisions.why: SH-INS describes the shields as "curved round the corner". STL-EF uses R250.

decisions.what: Leak pits (700 × 700 × 600, Rev K) sit on the kettle centreline at Y ±2,000 under the hearth. Each has a sacrificial 25 mm board over a 700 × 700 hearth opening, a steel chute through the grillage, and a locally thickened pad.
decisions.why: Rev K gives the size only. Under a suspended kettle, the hearth is where escaping zinc goes.

decisions.what: Furnace pit: RCC 200 retaining walls run along the casing long sides and join the burner pits. A 119 mm ventilated gap is left round the casing, with grating at FFL.
decisions.why: The casing is sunk 1.575 m. The plant model showed no wall between the casing and the soil.

decisions.what: Two pit fans, 3 HP each, one per burner pit, extracting at pit-floor level.
decisions.why: The source shows one fan. Both pits hold a gas train, and LPG is heavier than air.

decisions.what: The flue runs in an internally lined steel duct: 700 × 400 clear, lined with 100 module + 50 microporous inside 6 mm steel. It sits on supports in a vented RCC trench 1,260 wide.
decisions.why: Rev H's 230 IFB + 50 fibre trench gives RCC at 90–350 °C and a cover plate at ≈120 °C, and its 700 × 1,000 section runs at 2.2 m/s, slow enough for ash to settle. The duct runs at 5.4 m/s, with RCC ≈64 °C.

decisions.what: The dryer clear chamber is 6,000 × 7,500 × 1,400.
decisions.why: It takes the 7.4 m jig beam and the 7.6 m doors. Rev H's 7,000 would not.

decisions.what: The supply and extraction boxes are 1,300 × 350 × 7,000, centre-fed and centre-drawn. Each face is 7,000 × 1,000, perforated Ø15 @ 37 staggered 60° (14.9 % open, ≈5,900 holes).
decisions.why: Hole ΔP / feed velocity pressure = 2.05 (the uniform-spread criterion is ≥ 2). Rev H's end feed gave 0.30. A 350 mm depth keeps the box face 400 mm from the P1 centreline.

decisions.what: Equipment around the furnace is re-placed: combustion blower plinth at X +2.7…+4.1 m, pit fans east of each pit, gas skid at Y −7.6 m.
decisions.why: In the HDG layout the blower sat inside the 150 × 150 air ring and the pit fan sat on the blower.

decisions.what: The dryer pit lining is 100 mm ceramic-fibre board with a 1 mm aluminium liner.
decisions.why: RCC is 62 °C with 100 mm, against 77 °C with 50 mm.

decisions.what: Ventilated foundation: the casing sits on an ISMB 150 grillage at 600 c/c on the pad. Pad top is −1.725 and underside −2.325. The channels open into the pit gaps.
decisions.why: It keeps the pad top at ≤ 65 °C under a hot hearth. Rev K's pad (3,000 × 8,500 × 600) is kept, 150 mm lower.

decisions.what: Dryer top: a 250 mm insulated kerb runs round the pit, with a fixed cover over P2–P3 flush with the kerb. The doors run on rails above both.
decisions.why: In the HDG model the doors and the fixed cover sat at the same height and would collide.

decisions.what: Casing 8,200 × 2,750 is an inside dimension. The outside is 8,212 × 2,762 plus stiffeners.
decisions.why: This matches the SH-INS reconciliation (casing inner) and Rev H's 700 mm gap stack.

decisions.what: Gas enters the skid at A1 on the east. A11 sits at the west end nearest the furnace.
decisions.why: The run is shorter, with no doubling back.

decisions.what: *Superseded by D-22.* The recirculation blower was 250 mm further west than in the HDG model, to fit the straightener spool.
*Superseded by D-22.* The discharge trench ran west along Y −7.55…−8.65 m under the blower.
Combustion air is set at λ = 1.125 (12.5 % excess air).
decisions.why: Rev H's 1,132 Nm³/h is λ ≈ 1.00, too lean for pulse-fired HV burners. Full fire at λ 1.125 needs ≈1,430 m³/h at 35 °C (O-04).

decisions.what: The recirculation blower sits at the SW corner, where the discharge trench turns north into the dryer (owner's instruction, 21 Nov 2026). The fan axis stays at +0.900 on the mixing-box cut-out, so a straight Ø1100 duct, ≈6.6 m, runs from the mixing box to a 1100 → 900 reducer, the straightener spool and the inlet flexible. The 900 × 675 outlet drops straight into the corner of the 1,100 × 1,000 trench. Only the suction duct gets longer; the discharge trench is now one straight run north. The bleed riser moves to just downstream of the blower and runs overhead at +4.0 to the stack.
decisions.why: Owner's instruction. Ø1100 keeps the suction duct at ≈12.9 m/s and adds ≈1 mmWC; the shorter discharge removes ≈8 m of trench and two bends, so the loop total falls to ≈71 mmWC.

decisions.what: SH-PID-02A Rev U governs the combustion hardware. The model follows its bill of material tag for tag: train A1–A11, per-burner main legs B4 → B2 + B2 → B1 → B3 → B5 and ignition legs C3 → C1 → C2 + C2 → C4 → C19, the merge tee and single 2" inlet, C12 direct-spark ignitor (no pilot), C6 UV with ½" cooling air, C7/C8 close to the burner, C5 BCU 370, and the air side D1–D9 on the AEP-VB-2.5 7.5 HP blower. The Mittal MBI-4040 named in the HDG plant model and the Rev H venturi arrangement are not used.
decisions.why: Rev U is the as-ordered P&ID (Eclipse PO STL/2026/206, Bloom PO 1018).
decisions.src: SH-PID-02A Rev U, SH-PID-02 Rev M, HDG

decisions.what: Zinc fume enclosure: the wall plane is the casing outer face. Corner posts SHS 120 stand on the deck over the casing walls; ISMB 300 door-head girts at +2.456 span the corner posts, so both long sides open full length for skimming. Vertical-lift skimming doors run in guides outside the wall plane, with the 4 windows each at eye level from FFL. Two roof covers split on the centreline with the 200 mm rope slot and slide 1.4 m outward on rails carried on outriggers at both end walls. Slot plenums 500 × 700 inside both top edges collect into a 600 × 700 header outside the north end wall; the Ø700 outlet leaves north then east.
decisions.why: The annexure's 8,200 × 2,750 equals the casing inside; standing the posts over the casing walls is the only way to put the enclosure "on the casing deck" without loading the top closure. Inside to the sheeting is 8,212 × 2,762.

decisions.what: Skimming doors stop at a 1,000 mm lift for skimming, and only one side can be open at a time. Full lift (2,150) is for maintenance.
decisions.why: One door at the skimming stop keeps the open-face velocity at 0.61 m/s, above the 0.5 m/s minimum for an enclosing hood on a hot process. Both doors, or one at full lift, drop it to 0.30–0.33 m/s.

open.what: Trench depth, Hold H1. Rev H uses a uniform 1,000 mm. The R-02 foundation drawings show −1,400 / −1,000 with a 1,260 × 1,780 section. The model uses 1,000 clear (and D-10 for the flue).
Flue temperature at the tap point is not confirmed. All loop figures assume 800 °C.
Bloom HV-400 GA. The burner body in the model is an envelope (Ø380 × 520 + Ø460 × 170 flange). Rated gas and air inlet pressures are also needed.
open.effect: Burner block, pit layout, C-05, C-06

open.what: AEP-VB-2.5 rating basis (actual or normal m³/h). SH-PID-02A Rev U fixes the blower and its 7.5 HP motor; the 1,400 m³/h at 725 mmWC duty comes from Rev H. Full fire at λ 1.125 needs ≈1,430 m³/h at 35 °C. At λ 1.125 the blower supports ≈1,147 kW. Production needs ≈760–840 kW, so the limit only applies at full fire.
Stack height and sampling port against the SPCB consent.
PNG supply pressure and J125-S4 outlet set point. Pipework loss skid → north burner is ≈6 mbar at full fire.
AEP-ZA-9.0: is 72 mmWC rated at 20 °C or at 120 °C? The loop needs ≈71 mmWC hot with centre-fed boxes and the corner blower (D-22). A 20 °C rating gives only ≈54 mmWC hot.
Rev K skin target of 53–55 °C cannot be reached in 250 mm at a 900–1,000 °C hot face. D-05 gives 61–65 °C. Either accept that, or thicken locally where people stand.
Mixing-box handing. The blower cut-out face differs between Rev N (right face) and SH-MB-01 Rev A (left face). The model follows SH-MB-01 (west face).
*Closed.* Burner count: SH-PID-02A Rev U and Bloom PO 1018 give 4 HV-400 for two furnaces, 2 per furnace.
Kettle maker's design: creep at 450 °C, corner stresses, bulge allowance, plate chemistry (Si ≤ 0.03 %, P ≤ 0.02 %), UT and RT.
Structural design of the grillage, cap beam, furnace and burner pit walls, trench walls, blower plinths and stack foundation.

Combustion safety review of the burner management, gas train and purge against the applicable standard (EN 746-2 / NFPA 86), by a competent person. The model shows the PID-02 hardware. It makes no compliance claim.
Dryer chain drive: VFD or torque limiter. Door clear opening against the longest jig.
Pit fan duty. Each fan needs ≥ 189 m³/h (20 air changes per hour of a 9.45 m³ pit). Confirm the 3 HP fan's curve.

Zinc-fume bag filter (ZFE) location, fan and duct route beyond the flanged stub. The model stops the Ø700 at X +4.6 m, north of the furnace. The fan must cover ≈52 mmWC hood loss plus the filter and duct.
Enclosure structure: posts, girts, outriggers and the deck connection over the casing walls (D-24), and wind on the 4.7 m walls.
Door interlock: only one skimming door open at a time, and the skimming stop at 1,000 mm (D-25), to be written into the enclosure control logic.

SH-PID-02A Rev U start-up sequence text still says "PILOT: C2 opens, C7 sparks at C18, C6 must prove the pilot" and lists trip C17. Neither C17 nor C18 is on the bill of material, and note 2 says direct spark through C12 with no pilot. Correct the sequence to: ignition gas C2 opens, C7 sparks at C12, C6 proves the ignition flame.

holds.what: Does the HV-400 take a single gas inlet with the ignition gas merged? Confirm with Bloom before the pipework is fixed.
holds.where: NG-50-1x3 merge tee and 2" inlet, status open

holds.what: D1 is tapped on the blower discharge, so a shut D2 at a burner is not detected.
Parasitic circulation in the closed ring. Allow for it when the purge time is set.
A10 command authority undefined: one train, four burners, nobody assigned. A10 must close on any burner lockout and on emergency stop.
Air impulse to B1: 1" per the valve GA, ¼" tube on the P&ID. Measure on site.
D2, D6, C19 and the UV cooling air items are on neither purchase order. Raise them or the burners cannot be balanced or isolated.
holds.where: D2, C19, C9, C11, CA-15-101 marked "to order"

assumptions.what: Fuel is methane; this reproduces Rev H's 9.9 kWh/Nm³ LHV. PNG with 2–5 % C2+ changes air and flue by < 2 %.
Conductivity of 64 kg/m³ blanket: k = 0.020 + 0.00027·T (typical 1260-grade data). Replace with the supplier's sheet.
*Closed.* Combustion blower motor 7.5 HP = 5.5 kW, now in SH-PID-02A Rev U.
Enclosure air 50 °C for the extraction losses (C-15).
Skimming-door windows sit in the doors at a +1.300 sill (eye level from FFL); the annexure does not place them.
Safe bearing capacity 150 kN/m². The pad bears ≈49 kN/m².
Ventilated foundation channels at 50 °C air, h = 12 W/m²K at the casing underside. Flue trench air at 45 °C.
Lining hot face 1,000 °C for design, 1,100 °C beside the burner blocks.
assumptions.cons: Conservative for most of the wall

assumptions.what: SS 310S, 6 mm, for the corner shield plates. 12 mm for the lip plate (SH-INS also assumed this).
Mean steel cp 0.52 kJ/kg K, jig mass 12 % of work, zinc pickup 5 % (STL-EF basis).
